A serverless function needs to read one object prefix from a storage bucket. Its role currently has wildcard storage read and write across the account. Design a least-privilege change and a safe validation approach.

Map the function's actual operations and required object prefix, then replace account-wide wildcard permissions with the narrowest resource and actions supported by the platform. Separate read and write roles if different workflows need them, and avoid granting bucket administration when object access is sufficient. Test in a non-production environment with positive access to the required prefix and negative access to unrelated prefixes and destructive actions. Monitor denied requests after rollout and retain a rollback plan that does not restore unnecessary broad access by default.
